name: NC-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Foushee running with large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~96%
model.rationale: The district's D+23 lean, an incumbent Democrat, and a massive fundraising and outside-spending advantage leave the Republican challenger with no visible path. Markets price a Democratic win near certainty, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any late polling or unexpected outside spending surge for the challenger would be the only signal of movement in this safely Democratic seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
North Carolina's 4th District is a strongly Democratic seat in the Research Triangle, with a partisan lean of D+23. Incumbent Valerie Foushee is running for reelection and holds every structural advantage: incumbency, a fundraising total of more than $900,000, and over $2.3 million in outside support, against a Republican challenger who has raised roughly $12,000. A Libertarian is also on the ballot but has shown no measurable activity.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals and the financial imbalance. Markets price a Democratic win at about 96 percent. The seat is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being the absence of polling rather than any evidence of competition.
